text:
pagerduty: 🚨 PagerDuty: high error rate detected for service=embeddings-us-west-2 (5xx spike, 503s and 429s). Trigger: threshold breach (5m) — escalation policy: inference-prod.

incident-bot: Bridge created: <https://redwood.incidents/bridge/INC-1778123456|INC-1778123456> — runbook: embeddings/partial-degradation. PagerDuty details -> https://pd.local/alerts/PD-98765 :pagerduty:

maya-ops: ack'd — I'm oncall for US tonight, taking ownership. Jumping on bridge now. :raised_hand:

aj-molina: joining. seeing elevated 429s from a small subset of tenants (hot key pattern) in the metrics dashboard.

maya-ops: confirm which path — /v1/embeddings or async queue?

aj-molina: primarily /v1/embeddings generate endpoint. 99th latency up and a bunch of 429s correlating with tenant_id=acct_6f3a.

devon-w: :eyes: checking ingress logs, looks like requests are hammering a single shard of the embeddings router; circuit breakers tripped and we fell back to 503 for a portion of traffic.

sarah-griffin: adding runbook step 1: identify offending tenant and apply temporary throttling. step 2: scale routing pool up + restart router pod if stuck.

maya-ops: doing step 1 now. aj, can you dump the last 10k hits for acct_6f3a?

aj-molina: pasted sample logs to bridge channel. snippet:

```
POST /v1/embeddings 200ms tenant=acct_6f3a model=text-embed-1 payload_size=24kb
POST /v1/embeddings 12ms tenant=acct_6f3a model=text-embed-1 payload_size=2kb
... repeated ~4.5k reqs/min from ~10 ip ranges
```

lucas-k: looks like a retry storm from their client. We should blacklist ips short-term and enable per-tenant rate limit throttle.

maya-ops: I'm going to add a temporary policy to per-tenant rate limiter: cap acct_6f3a to 10 rps. Command: 

```bash
curl -X POST https://console.internal/rate-limiter/policies \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"tenant":"acct_6f3a","rate":10,"ttl":300}'
```

maya-ops: applied. monitoring...

(devon-w reacts :thumbsup: )

aj-molina: after rate limit applied, 429s dropped but 503s persist for ~5% of requests — likely router pod still unhealthy.

maya-ops: triggering a rolling restart of the embeddings-router kneelers in us-west-2. command:

```bash
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deployment/embeddings-router-us-west-2
kubectl -n inference scale deployment/embeddings-router-us-west-2 --replicas=8
```

maya-ops: initiated restart and scale. giving 30s for pods to come up.

sarah-griffin: propose fallback: route high-latency tenants to a lower-capacity best-effort embedding model (text-embed-lite) to keep customers receiving responses while we stabilize.

lucas-k: agree. I'll patch routing rule for acct_6f3a to use text-embed-lite until we clear.

lucas-k: patched route -> acct_6f3a now routed to text-embed-lite (TTL 10m).

maya-ops: seeing success rate improving. errors down to baseline ~0.5% and latency normalized.

aj-molina: adding note for customer impact: affected tenant acct_6f3a saw degraded quality (model downgrade) and rate limiting for ~12 minutes. No other tenants impacted.

devon-w: copied logs/artifacts to S3: s3://redwood-incidents/INC-1778123456/artifacts.tar.gz

maya-ops: starting post-mortem stub in docs workspace. assigning follow-ups:
- aj-molina: confirm client retry behavior and recommend backoff fixes to customer
- lucas-k: implement auto-detect for hot-keyed tenants and automatic per-tenant soft-throttles
- devon-w: add health-check improvements for router so circuit-breaker recovers gracefully

maya-ops: handoff to devon-w for deeper fix/longer-term ops, I'll remain reachable for any escalations.

devon-w: taking over incident ownership. ETA for deep fix triage 2h. will update here.

maya-ops: thanks — marking incident as mitigated in bridge, leaving bridge open for follow-up notes. :white_check_mark:

pagerduty: Alert resolved: PD-98765 — triggered at 1778123456, acknowledged by maya-ops at 1778123460, resolved at 1778123498.

devon-w: posting brief to #postmortems/embeddings with timeline and artifacts. will schedule follow-up next-week.

sarah-griffin: quick customer comm draft: "We detected elevated request rates causing degraded embedding responses for one customer; we applied temporary throttling and routing to a fallback model to protect overall service. We are following up with the customer and implementing auto-throttling to prevent recurrence." ping me for edits.

maya-ops: thanks team. closing thread after postmortem doc created. :lock_with_ink_pen:
